chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah sees only good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq presents this concept within the framework of divine justice (*Adl*), asserting that Allah’s perception is not limited to good but is exclusively good because He is the source of all perfection. This view counters the Mu'tazili and Khawarij extremes, emphasizing that divine decree is inherently wise and beneficial, even when perceived as hardship by humans. It underscores the Shia belief in a benevolent Creator whose attributes are pure and free from deficiency.
